history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the United Nations Integrated Office in Haiti (BINUH) reassess vehicle requirements in the light of operational demands in future.
history.administration_response: As noted in the Board’s report, vehicle requirements are routinely assessed based on future demand of BINUH, which is subject to change due to the mission’s evolving mandate and operational environment. As soon as possible, a BINUH Vehicle Establishment Committee will be convened to review and determine the actual needs of the mission based on newly mandated tasks pursuant to Security Council resolution 2814 (2026) and allotment ratios. All assets above the allotment limit will then either be transferred to other United Nations entities or written off.
history.board_assessment: Given that BINUH will convene the Vehicle Establishment Committee to reassess vehicle requirements in line with its updated mandate and allotment ratios, and plans to transfer or write off surplus assets, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
